playbookOutputs: Draft Annual Financial Statements (statement of financial position, statement of comprehensive income, changes in equity, cash flows, notes)
Signed Annual Financial Statements with compilation report by Kevin Freese, CBA(SA) #3561
Final trial balance and adjusting journals schedule
playbookCommonFailures: Client-supplied trial balance does not balance or does not agree to the general ledger
Bank balance per trial balance does not agree to the year-end bank statement (no reconciliation supplied)
Opening balances do not agree to the prior year's signed AFS
Asset register missing so depreciation cannot be verified; fixed asset additions unsupported
Directors delay signing the representation letter and the AFS, stalling sign-off

informationToProvide.label: Complete general ledger for the financial year
alternatives: Read-only accountant access to Xero / Sage / QuickBooks
informationToProvide.aiHint: Detailed general ledger export (Excel/CSV or PDF) covering the full financial year for the entity. Must show account, date, description and amount per transaction. Accept accountant invite to the client's accounting software as an alternative.

informationToProvide.label: Trial Balance for the financial year
informationToProvide.aiHint: Year-end trial balance for the entity with debits equal to credits. Check the period end matches the company's financial year end on CIPC. Reject a trial balance for a different period or in a different entity's name.

informationToProvide.label: Bank statements and reconciliations
informationToProvide.aiHint: Original electronic PDF bank statements for every business account for the full financial year (no scans or photos), plus the year-end bank reconciliation if the client prepares one. Confirm the closing balance on the last statement agrees to the bank balance on the trial balance.

informationToProvide.label: Asset register and depreciation schedule
informationToProvide.aiHint: Fixed asset register listing each asset, cost, date acquired, depreciation method/rate, accumulated depreciation and carrying value. If none exists, ask for invoices of assets bought or sold during the year so one can be built.

informationToProvide.label: Previous year's Annual Financial Statements (if available)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed prior-year AFS for the same entity. Used for opening balances and comparatives. Accept the prior-year trial balance if the AFS were never prepared, and flag that comparatives will be unaudited/unreviewed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect ledger, trial balance, bank statements and asset register
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: General ledger, trial balance, full-year bank statements and asset register uploaded; prior AFS uploaded or confirmed not available
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: This service is drafting and sign-off only — the client already keeps books. Chase only what is missing and explain why each item is needed (e.g. the asset register supports the depreciation note; the prior AFS gives opening balances). Confirm the financial year end and the reporting framework (IFRS for SMEs is the default for a private company unless Kevin says otherwise). Do not promise anything faster than 7–10 working days from receipt of everything.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify the trial balance and bank statements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: TB balances, agrees to the GL, and the year-end bank balance agrees to the bank statement; opening balances agree to prior AFS
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check: (1) debits = credits on the TB; (2) TB account totals agree to the GL export; (3) closing bank balance per TB agrees to the last bank statement of the year for every account; (4) opening retained earnings and balance sheet items agree to the prior-year signed AFS; (5) the period on every document is the same financial year. List every difference with the amount and post it as a query for Kevin. Do not attempt to fix the client's books at this step.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Import trial balance into AI Accountant and map accounts
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: TB imported into the AI Accountant module, every account mapped to an AFS line item, bank statements imported for the reconciliation check
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: In the AI Accountant module: create/select the client entity and financial year, import the trial balance, and map each account to the statement line (revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses, PPE, loans, etc.). Import the bank statement PDFs so the module can reconcile the bank balance. Unmapped or suspense accounts must be listed for Kevin, not silently mapped to 'other'. Load the asset register so depreciation can be recomputed and compared to the client's figure.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Review trial balance and post adjusting journals
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin has reviewed the mapped TB, approved adjusting journals (depreciation, accruals, loan interest, tax) and the final TB is locked
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Prepare a proposal for Kevin listing suggested adjustments: depreciation differences against the asset register, unreconciled bank items, director loan balances that need interest or confirmation, income tax and provisional tax payments to be shown as current tax, and any negative balances that look like classification errors. Kevin decides; the agent never posts a journal without approval. ⚠ verify: the applicable reporting framework and whether the company's Public Interest Score requires independent review or audit rather than compilation — if so stop and tell Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft the AFS pack
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Draft AFS generated from the locked TB and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Generate the afs_pack from the final TB: directors' responsibility statement, compilation report (Kevin Freese CBA(SA) #3561 — signature applied only at approval), statement of financial position, statement of comprehensive income, statement of changes in equity, statement of cash flows, accounting policies and notes, and the detailed income statement as a supplementary schedule. Populate company name, registration number, directors and year end from the CoR14.3 on file; never guess a director's name. Comparatives come from the prior AFS — if none, label comparatives clearly. Check the statements cross-cast and the cash flow reconciles to the bank movement.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send draft AFS and representation letter to directors
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Directors have confirmed the draft (or raised queries) and returned the signed directors' responsibility statement and representation letter
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Plain South African English. Explain that these are draft AFS for the year ended [date], list the queries Kevin still needs answered, and ask the directors to review, then sign the directors' responsibility statement and the management representation letter where marked and return as PDF. No deadline threats. If the client asks for changes to figures, route them to Kevin as a proposal — do not change numbers to please the client.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver signed AFS
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed AFS PDF and final TB posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the signed AFS (Kevin's compilation report signed, directors' signatures in place), the final trial balance and the adjusting journals schedule. Add a short note on what the AFS are needed for next: the ITR14 company tax return and the CIPC annual return, and offer those services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the AFS are signed and the order can be completed
